SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Vowel Contraction s in German Braille • au-dot 1,6 • au-dot 3,4 • ei-dot 1,4,6 • eu- dot1,2,6, • ie-dot 3,4,6., part of German Braille. in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How can we recognize and use different vowel contractions correctly in German Braille?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

1. explore Braille flashcards or Braille charts with single vowel contractions using their fingers to identify and differentiate the patterns and discuss with their peers,

2. read Braille words and short sentences containing vowel contractions aloud to a peer or teacher for guided pronunciation correction,
